mapper.select:
SELECT distinct a.id, a.code, a.type, a.create_name, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.status, a.warehouse_id, a.affirm_time, a.affirm_name, a.out_time, a.product_line_id, a.product_line_name, a.note FROM wms_delivery_receipt a LEFT JOIN wms_delivery_receipt_info b ON b.delivery_receipt_id = a.id LEFT JOIN wms_inventory c on c.id = b.inventory_id
a.del_flag = 0
AND a.status = #{dto.status}
and a.code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{dto.code},'%')
and a.type = #{dto.type}
and c.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{dto.materialName},'%')
and c.material_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{dto.materialCode},'%')
and c.shelf_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{dto.shelfCode},'%')
and c.shelf_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{dto.shelfName},'%')
and a.warehouse_id in
#{id}
and c.batch like CONCAT('%',#{dto.batch},'%')
and c.case_no like CONCAT('%',#{dto.caseNo},'%')
and a.create_Name like CONCAT('%',#{dto.createName},'%')
and a.affirm_Name like CONCAT('%',#{dto.affirmName},'%')
and a.create_time between #{dto.createStartTime} and #{dto.createEndTime}
and a.affirm_time between #{dto.affirmStartTime} and #{dto.affirmEndTime}
order By a.update_time desc

SELECT dr.linked_id , inventory.case_no as code FROM wms_delivery_receipt dr JOIN wms_delivery_receipt_info info ON dr.id = info.delivery_receipt_id JOIN wms_inventory inventory on info.inventory_id = inventory.id Where dr.del_flag = 0 and info.del_flag = 0 and inventory.del_flag = 0 and dr.linked_id in
#{id}

select date(b.create_time) as sendDate, a.associated_no as code, count(*) as pieceQty, b.type as typeId from wms_delivery_receipt_info a join wms_delivery_receipt b on a.delivery_receipt_id = b.id where b.type = 1582297407643815936 GROUP BY a.associated_no,b.type,date(b.create_time) ORDER BY date(b.create_time) DESC,b.type,a.associated_no DESC

SELECT distinct d.customer_barcode FROM wms_delivery_receipt a JOIN wms_delivery_receipt_info b ON b.delivery_receipt_id = a.id JOIN wms_inventory c ON c.id = b.inventory_id JOIN wms_customer_barcode d ON d.case_no = c.case_no WHERE a.sales_order = #{salesOrder} AND b.del_flag = 0 AND d.del_flag = 0
SELECT sum(b.quantity) FROM wms_delivery_receipt a JOIN wms_delivery_receipt_info b ON b.delivery_receipt_id = a.id WHERE a.sales_order = #{salesOrder} and a.status = 1 AND b.del_flag = 0

SELECT COUNT(a.id) FROM wms_delivery_receipt a JOIN wms_delivery_receipt_info b ON a.id = b.delivery_receipt_id JOIN wms_inventory c on c.id = b.inventory_id WHERE a.del_flag = 0 AND a.`status` = 0 AND b.del_flag = 0 AND c.shelf_id in
#{shelfId}

SELECT b.associated_no FROM wms_delivery_receipt a JOIN wms_delivery_receipt_info b ON b.delivery_receipt_id = a.id JOIN wms_inventory c ON c.id = b.inventory_id JOIN wms_customer_barcode d ON d.case_no = c.case_no WHERE d.customer_barcode = #{customerBarcode} AND b.del_flag = 0 AND d.del_flag = 0

/*查询出库创建信息*/ select c.case_no as caseNo, c.warehouse_id as warehouseId, c.shelf_name as shelfName, b.product_line_name as productLineName, b.code as associatedNo, b.create_time as operateTime, b.create_name as operator, c.material_id as materialId, a.quantity as quantity, '出库单创建' AS operateType, b.type AS typeId from wms_delivery_receipt_info a join wms_delivery_receipt b on a.delivery_receipt_id = b.id join wms_inventory c on a.inventory_id = c.id WHERE c.case_no = #{caseNo} UNION /*查询出库确认信息*/ select c.case_no as caseNo, c.warehouse_id as warehouseId, c.shelf_name as shelfName, b.product_line_name as productLineName, b.code as associatedNo, b.affirm_time as operateTime, b.affirm_name as operator, c.material_id as materialId, a.quantity as quantity, '出库单确认' AS operateType, b.type AS typeId from wms_delivery_receipt_info a join wms_delivery_receipt b on a.delivery_receipt_id = b.id join wms_inventory c on a.inventory_id = c.id WHERE c.case_no = #{caseNo} AND (b.affirm_name is NOT NULL OR b.affirm_time IS NOT NULL) UNION /*查询出库明细删除信息*/ select c.case_no as caseNo, c.warehouse_id as warehouseId, c.shelf_name as shelfName, b.product_line_name as productLineName, b.code as associatedNo, a.update_time as operateTime, a.update_name as operator, c.material_id as materialId, a.quantity as quantity, '出库单明细删除' AS operateType, b.type AS typeId from wms_delivery_receipt_info a join wms_delivery_receipt b on a.delivery_receipt_id = b.id join wms_inventory c on a.inventory_id = c.id WHERE a.del_flag = 1 AND c.case_no = #{caseNo} UNION /*查询出库单删除信息*/ select c.case_no as caseNo, c.warehouse_id as warehouseId, c.shelf_name as shelfName, b.product_line_name as productLineName, b.`code` as associatedNo, b.update_time as operateTime, b.update_name as operator, c.material_id as materialId, a.quantity as quantity, '出库单删除' AS operateType, b.type AS typeId from wms_delivery_receipt_info a join wms_delivery_receipt b on a.delivery_receipt_id = b.id join wms_inventory c on a.inventory_id = c.id WHERE b.del_flag = 1 AND c.case_no = #{caseNo}
